August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 116)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 25 across American network, three eras of Bing Crosby (including GE small appliances and duets with Rosemary Clooney), Tommy Dorsey's big band swing for Lucky Strike cigarettes, the thrilling serial finale of The Twilight Terror with Nick Carter, and inspirational rehabilitation dramas on America on the March for the DAV (1943–1961):
